validation: Same source (d929d92) installed application-only over USB on a JC-P4 (chip rev 1.3) with saved configuration retained; booted on Ethernet DHCP, M31 polling, Dashboard, Tags, Rules, Maintenance and Firmware Update pages returned 200. This clean rebuild was not separately installed.
notes: JC only. Current JC/P4-LCD feature line: Logger, Rules email controls, Tag Manager, on-controller firmware check/update/restore, configurable serial ports. Application-only image; preserves the installed bootloader and saved configuration. Controllers on 20261016 or older have no updater and need a one-time USB install.
